secondaryModule: D10-09 上游→中游→下游不對稱傳導
purpose: 完成 SC-054 指定的第二條真正實體非鋼鐵三層鏈，沿用已事前凍結的 1M/2M/3M lag 候選，不事後挑 lag；以官方台灣月度產銷存資料檢查 generic fixed-lag 是否可重播。

preregistration.interpretationRule: Report both physical edges separately. No lag may be selected because it looks best on one edge. No composite success score.

physicalEvidence.authority: TPCA 台灣電路板協會會員資料
physicalEvidence.evidence: 會員公司說明銅箔、樹脂等為 CCL 主要原物料，且產品應用於 PCB。

physicalEvidence.authority: TPCA 台灣電路板協會會員資料
physicalEvidence.evidence: 銅箔基板可供 PCB 廠加工製成單、雙面及多層印刷電路板。
銅箔基板是電路板主要材料。

physicalChain.taxonomyBoundary: The chain is physical at product-family level, not an issuer-specific bill of materials. Product-code identity does not prove every Taiwan copper-foil unit is consumed by the observed CCL universe or every CCL unit by the observed PCB universe.

sourceFamily.pitCaveat: The 2025 annual report is historical replay evidence. It does not preserve each 2025 month's native first-known publication timestamp, so it cannot by itself establish prospective PIT timing. Future monthly receipts must freeze sourcePublishedAt/capturedAt.

primaryReplay.keyFalsification: The 2M lag is strongest on copper-foil→CCL but weak on CCL→PCB; the 3M lag is stronger on CCL→PCB but only 50% on copper-foil→CCL. A generic fixed lag cannot be selected without cherry-picking the edge.

sensitivityReplay.metric: upstream shipment direction -> downstream production direction
sensitivityReplay.interpretation: Sensitivity also flips the best-looking lag across edges. It is not a promotion test and cannot replace the preregistered primary metric.

controlsAndCounterevidence: Layer units differ, so level ratios across copper foil, CCL and PCB are invalid; only within-series changes may be compared.
Inventory can absorb or release upstream production before downstream production changes.
Monthly production can share common end-demand shocks, especially electronics/AI demand, so concordance is not causal evidence.
Product-family data are not issuer-matched supplier-customer quantities.
Adjacent monthly pairs are serially dependent and the 2025 sample is small.
Historical annual-report replay is ex-post; native monthly first-known clocks are not frozen.
No stock-return, revenue, margin or issuer score outcome is opened.
reasonNoD10_02L3: SC-055 removes the prior physical-graph blocker but the relation itself remains unstable: no one preregistered lag works consistently across both physical edges, native monthly PIT clocks are not preserved by the annual replay, common-demand/inventory alternatives remain material, and there is no prospective/OOS confirmation.

systemImplications.system1: Do not add a generic supply-chain fixed-lag score, bonus or timing rule.
systemImplications.system2: Research context may store chain-specific state plus UNKNOWN/confidence, but no timing vote is authorized.

exactNext: SC-056 prospectively append the same copper-foil→CCL→PCB chain from native monthly MOEA releases with sourcePublishedAt/capturedAt frozen before later outcomes.
Keep the 1M/2M/3M lag set and the production-direction primary metric unchanged; do not select a different lag or metric after seeing new months.
Continue steel-chain future vintages under the same frozen lag set.

If independent future physical chains continue to show edge-specific or unstable lag behavior, classify generic fixed-lag supply-chain timing as rejected and retain only chain-specific contextual state.
